# Requirements: Widget

## v1 (must have)

- REQ-01: A drive parameter, range 0..100%, default 25%.
- REQ-02: Waveshaping with antiderivative antialiasing.
- REQ-03: Output gain compensation so drive does not change perceived loudness.
- REQ-04: A webview UI with a single knob and a level meter.

## Out of scope

- Oversampling controls, tone stack, presets.
